reviewer.scope: Verified the fixed fresh review and its input bindings; compared its major findings with the existing primary and numeric audits. This is not a second blind audit, independent human reliability validation, or a claim that parent root personally performed this full check.

status_meaning: PASS means the checked references, extracted claims and reconciliation record are consistent; it does not mean the model output is correct.

binding_verification.method: Resolve each declared file and JSON Pointer in the four allowed inputs. Match exact quote spans/substrings, typed scalar/object/array values and numeric/identifier character spans. Decode compact fact tables using shared metadata plus row columns. Structured citation scopes may be their containing context object rather than a string. Parsed JSON numeric spelling differences (1e-06 versus 0.000001) are equivalent values, not quote corruption.

checker_granularity_corrections.fact_table_shared_pointers: Fourteen preliminary mismatches arose because the generic checker looked for common_market_json_pointer only in row columns. Singleton tables store it in shared metadata; decoding the merged table resolves all fourteen.
checker_granularity_corrections.structured_claim_scopes: One hundred five preliminary mismatches arose from requiring citation scope to be a string. The declared context/other container objects are valid scopes enclosing the citation array; all 173 declared scopes resolve. These were checker assumptions, not review corrections.

binding_verification.limits: Expected numeric values and conversion fields were checked against the supplied evidence or declared task/raw vector. This verifies extraction and arithmetic, not public-data authenticity or all subjective semantic classifications.

coverage_units.interpretation: The fresh 162 includes two stages and 22 raw weights; primary 61 counts final narrative assertions, ranges and dates at a different granularity. The final fresh 62 prose tokens also need not equal primary 65 claim-covered tokens because enumeration of ranges/date tokens differs. None of these counts is a sample size, error rate, agreement percentage or composite score.

major_findings_reconciled.finding: Own D0 sum is exactly 1.02. Energy, Materials and Utilities each decline by 0.002; total change is -0.006 and final sum is 1.014, leaving 0.014. Risk names only Energy and Utilities; implication misnames the prior sum 1.02 as a residual. Both reviews distinguish a required target of 1.0 from the false achieved-sum claims in risk and allocation implication.
major_findings_reconciled.resolution: Consistent concrete facts; no raw repair or forced recoding.

major_findings_reconciled.finding: Both identify repeated wrong scales, signs or sector values. IT claims 149.92% versus supplied 14.9920%, daily mean 2.55% versus 0.25538%, and annual volatility 21.2% versus 33.6851%. Financials highest-return/highest-volatility claims conflict with visible ordering; IT has the highest compound return and Financials the lowest volatility.
major_findings_reconciled.resolution: Substantive errors persist despite visible citation IDs. No performance inference.

major_findings_reconciled.finding: Twelve months exceeds the roughly three-month lookback. The stated reverse comparison and strong-predictor inference are unsupported. Macro values do not uniquely prescribe sector weights.
major_findings_reconciled.resolution: Consistent; conditional economic interpretation is separated from contradicted facts.

major_findings_reconciled.finding: All eleven institutional-source fields consistently indicate no supplied institution. Source fidelity is N/A. All 77 final citations are visible; the fresh 173 also includes the 96 prior citations. Visibility alone does not support the nearby claim.
major_findings_reconciled.resolution: No source-absence penalty or inference of valid reasoning from labels/IDs.

major_findings_reconciled.finding: The fresh judge received raw evidence, not the external math sidecar. In the separately bound numeric audit, final 10000 units are [375,177,888,888,493,888,1183,3748,986,177,197]; own-D0 derived TV is 11/2000 (0.55%). All eight raw-unchanged sectors rise after normalization because the denominator changes from 1.02 to 1.014.
major_findings_reconciled.resolution: A derived 100% allocation does not make the raw sum-one assertion correct and does not supply new evidence to the masked judge.

preserved_qualifications.masked: support for the contextual limitation with explicit date qualifications
preserved_qualifications.reconciliation: Retain the distinction between June observations/policy and July releases; unknown subsequent revisions are not asserted as facts.

preserved_qualifications.subject: near/matching/low and relative interpretations
preserved_qualifications.reconciliation: Health Care raw 9% is close to the normalized reference about 8.9089%, not exact equality. Industrial volatility near baseline has no declared threshold (about 19.7182% versus 13.9023%). Interpretive labels, conditional alternatives and growth/defensive characterizations retain their qualifications; no optimal or unique weight follows. Any derived benchmark crossing is a separate math endpoint.

errors.reason: No discrepancy found in checked hashes, quote/value/pointer bindings or actual raw changes. Model arithmetic and factual errors remain explicit results.

consistency.reason: Exact own history and supplied inputs match. Stage/count units and ambiguous coding labels are preserved without a consensus accuracy claim.

paper_topic.reason: The review traces visible evidence to stated interpretation, reasons and allocation. The source-free control provides a descriptive contrast; citation visibility or a derived sum of 100% does not demonstrate sound evidence-to-choice reasoning.

unresolved: Interpretive categories remain qualified as stated above. This reconciliation does not independently authenticate the source data, assign weights to error severity, rank conditions, estimate causal effects or validate future returns.
